Gain entrance to [[House zu Heltzer]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Travel to [[Altrumm Ruins (outpost)|House zu Heltzer]]. {{sic|reads HzH, but should say AR outpost}}
*Speak with [[Guardsman Oldrich]] at Altrumm Ruins.
*See [[Count zu Heltzer]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*4,000 [[Experience]]
*250 [[Kurzick Faction]]
*1 [[Skill point]]

==Walkthrough==
Once you've obtained this quest from [[Jamei]], simply [[map-travel]] over to the [[Altrumm Ruins (outpost)|Altrumm Ruins]] and speak with [[Guardsman Oldrich]]. He will [[teleport]] your party into [[House zu Heltzer]], where you can collect your reward from [[Count zu Heltzer]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Jamei
''Master Togo wanted me to give you some special instructions before you visit the Kurzicks. You should know that above all, the Kurzicks respect creation above all else. Additionally, everything the Kurzicks do must first be approved by the council of nobles. I suggest that you use diplomacy and show respect to the Kurzick nobles. Speak with '''Count zu Heltzer''' in '''House zu Heltzer''' first. He has a great deal of influence and might be sympathetic to our cause. To find him, speak with '''Guardsman Oldrich''' in '''Altrumm Ruins'''<!--there's a space between "Ruins" and the "period"--> .{{sic}} This will allow access to House zu Heltzer.''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll seek out the count.
|decline = I haven't decided yet.
|ask = You know, I really have better things to do than to stand around here repeating the same information over and over again. One last time: If you hope to sway the Kurzicks, you will need to go to House zu Heltzer in Echovald Forest and speak with '''Count zu Heltzer'''. 
|indent = :: }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Guardsman Oldrich
''Let me get this straight, you and Mhenlo want to become Kurzicks? Count zu Heltzer will want to hear of this immediately! Let me know when you are ready to enter House zu Heltzer.''
:{{yes|ingame}} '''Let's go.'''
:''When you are ready to travel, I will take you in to House zu Heltzer. This is quite an honor. Not many outsiders are allowed in here.''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''I am ready.'''
::''Your entire party is about to be moved to the next area. Make sure all party members are ready first. Do you wish to continue?''
:::{{yes|ingame}} '''Yes.''' (sent to [[House zu Heltzer]].)
:::{{no|ingame}} '''No.'''
:{{no|ingame}} '''Not right now.'''

===Reward dialogue===
;Count zu Heltzer
''I thought Shiro had been dealt with using the sacred Urn of Saint Viktor? Master Togo's plan must have failed, then. Well, in any case, I cannot move the Kurzicks on the word of a stranger, and certainly the Redemptors will need to meditate on the matter and divine the will of the gods. If you truly wish to help in this effort, you must first prove yourself a friend. Once you have done so, I'll secure you an audience with the Council of Nobles.''
